name: accessoticketing-mcp
description: Read accesso-powered mobile ticket links: orders, admissions, barcodes and Google Wallet passes.
long_description: Reads the mobile-ticket links accesso Passport venues email after a purchase (theme parks, camps, festivals). Returns the order and every admission on it — product, participant, date, start time and merchant instructions — plus the scannable barcodes and Google Wallet save links. No login: the emailed link is the credential.

ticket_url.title: Default ticket link
ticket_url.description: Optional. An accesso ticket link from an order-confirmation email, used when a tool is called without one. Treat it as a secret — it grants the order's tickets.

output_dir.title: Barcode output directory
output_dir.description: Optional. Where saved barcode images are written. Defaults to the working directory.
